guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：拉曼顯微光譜儀
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: Raman microspectrometers
guides.concept: 從分子振動造成的非彈性散射出發，理解拉曼顯微光譜儀如何從比入射雷射弱十個數量級的散射光中取出化學與應力資訊，再把共軛焦取樣、邊緣濾光片、光柵色散、矽 520.7 cm⁻¹ 校正、螢光背景與雷射加熱整合成可交接的量測紀錄。
guides.conceptEn: Start from inelastic scattering by molecular vibrations to see how a Raman microspectrometer extracts chemical and stress information from light ten orders of magnitude weaker than the laser, then integrate confocal sampling, edge filters, grating dispersion, silicon 520.7 cm⁻¹ calibration, fluorescence background and laser heating into a transferable measurement record.
procedure: 雷射電場使分子電子雲極化，誘導偶極主要以入射頻率振盪而產生瑞利散射；若極化率隨某個振動座標改變，誘導偶極還會出現 ν₀ ± ν_vib 的邊帶，這就是拉曼散射。失去一個振動量子的是斯托克斯線，取得一個量子的是反斯托克斯線，後者強度受振動激發態的波茲曼佈居限制。拉曼位移 Δν̃ = 1/λ₀ − 1/λs 只與振動能階有關、與雷射波長無關，所以頻譜以 cm⁻¹ 為座標；散射功率約與 (ν̃₀ − Δν̃)⁴ 成正比，短波長激發的訊號較強，但也較容易激發螢光。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「雷射線與斯托克斯散射光」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

拉曼顯微光譜儀以高數值孔徑物鏡把雷射聚成繞射極限光點，同一支物鏡以背向散射幾何收集拉曼光，再經過與焦點共軛的針孔或狹縫，只讓焦平面附近的散射光進入光譜儀。橫向取樣直徑約 1.22λ/NA，軸向取樣深度由針孔大小決定，通常是橫向的兩到三倍；針孔越小深度越淺但通量越低。拉曼微分截面只有 10⁻²⁹ cm²/sr 等級，計數率正比於雷射光子數、分子數密度、取樣長度、收集立體角與光路透射率，任何一項打折都直接轉成更長的積分時間。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「物鏡焦點與共軛焦針孔」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

拉曼雷射需要窄線寬與穩定波長：線寬直接疊加到每一條拉曼峰上，波長漂移則直接變成位移誤差。半導體雷射的放大自發放射背景與氣體雷射的電漿線必須用窄帶淨化濾光片去除，否則會在頻譜上出現假峰。收集端的瑞利光與鏡面反射比拉曼光強六到十個數量級，需要光學密度 OD 6 以上的干涉式長波通邊緣濾光片或體布拉格光柵陷波濾光片；濾光片的過渡帶寬決定能量測的最低波數，入射角偏離設計值則讓截止邊往短波長移動。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「雷射淨化濾光片與邊緣濾光片」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

通過共軛焦針孔的拉曼光進入 Czerny–Turner 光譜儀：入口狹縫經準直鏡成為平行光，光柵依 mλ = d(sin α + sin β) 把不同波長分到不同角度，再由聚焦鏡成像到背照式 CCD。倒線色散 dλ/dx = cos β/(m·G·f) 決定每個像素對應的波數，狹縫影像寬度決定儀器線寬，CCD 長度決定單次曝光涵蓋的範圍；高刻線密度與長焦距提升解析度，卻縮小範圍並使寬頻譜需要拼接。CCD 以熱電或液態氮致冷到 −60 °C 以下壓低暗電流，並沿狹縫方向合併像素以降低讀出雜訊的比重。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「光柵光譜儀與 CCD 陣列」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

波數軸校正分兩步：先用氖、氬或汞燈已知的原子線把像素對應到絕對波長，修正光柵角與色散非線性；再用矽 520.7 cm⁻¹ 或其他已知拉曼峰定出雷射的實際波長，也就是零位移點，因為雷射波長漂移會讓整條位移軸平移。以矽峰位做應力計量時，單軸應力約每 cm⁻¹ 對應 500 MPa，所以 0.1 cm⁻¹ 的校正誤差就是 50 MPa 的應力誤差；峰位必須以洛倫茲或 Voigt 函數擬合取得次像素精度，燈線與雷射波長也必須一致地使用空氣或真空值。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「矽 520.7 cm⁻¹ 與氖燈校正線」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

拉曼截面比螢光小很多個數量級，樣品或雜質只要有微量螢光，寬廣的背景就會淹沒拉曼峰。背景可以用多項式扣掉平均值，但其散粒雜訊 √B 會留在頻譜裡，所以真正的訊噪比是 S/√(S + B + D + σ_read²)。對策包括改用 785 或 1064 nm 激發避開電子吸收、以雷射預先光漂白、時間閘控或移頻激發差分；換長波長會因 ν⁴ 與 CCD 量子效率下降而損失訊號，必須以訊噪比而非訊號大小決策。不同設定的相對強度還需用 NIST SRM 2241（785 nm 用）等螢光標準玻璃做儀器響應校正。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「螢光背景與 CCD 雜訊底」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

高 NA 物鏡把數 mW 集中在不到 1 µm 的光點，峰值功率密度達 MW/cm² 等級，被吸收的功率造成局部升溫；溫升與熱導率和光點半徑成反比，所以矽只升高數十 K，深色聚合物、碳材或生物組織卻可能燒毀或相變。升溫會讓峰位紅移、線寬變寬，若與應力或成分訊號混在一起就無法分離。拉曼成像把電動平台、自動對焦、曝光與讀出同步，整幅影像所需時間、焦面平整度與宇宙射線尖峰的處理都必須事先預算。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「雷射功率密度與成像平台」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

拉曼顯微光譜儀的驗收把前面的模型轉成固定測試：氖燈線形驗證儀器線寬與色散，矽 520.7 cm⁻¹ 驗證峰位、重複性與每 mW 計數率，Z 掃描驗證共軛焦深度，SRM 強度標準驗證相對響應，功率計在樣品面量實際功率，低波數與反斯托克斯量測驗證濾光片截止邊。交接紀錄須包含每個雷射與光柵組合的校正係數、物鏡與針孔設定、量得的線寬與計數率、環境溫度與樣品安全功率上限，因為任何一項改變都會讓跨日或跨機台的比較失效。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「矽、氖燈與強度標準驗收表」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: The laser field polarises the molecular electron cloud and the induced dipole oscillates mainly at the incident frequency, producing Rayleigh scattering; if the polarisability changes along a vibrational coordinate, the dipole also acquires sidebands at ν₀ ± ν_vib, which is Raman scattering. Losing one vibrational quantum gives the Stokes line and gaining one gives the anti-Stokes line, whose strength is limited by the Boltzmann population of the excited level. The Raman shift Δν̃ = 1/λ₀ − 1/λs depends only on the vibrational levels and not on the laser wavelength, so spectra are plotted in cm⁻¹; scattered power scales roughly as (ν̃₀ − Δν̃)⁴, so shorter-wavelength excitation gives stronger signals but also excites fluorescence more easily. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Laser line and Stokes-scattered light”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A Raman microspectrometer focuses the laser to a diffraction-limited spot with a high-numerical-aperture objective, collects the Raman light through the same objective in backscattering geometry, and passes it through a pinhole or slit conjugate to the focus so only light from near the focal plane enters the spectrometer. The lateral sampling diameter is about 1.22λ/NA while the axial sampling depth is set by the pinhole and is typically two to three times larger; a smaller pinhole gives a shallower depth but less throughput. Raman differential cross-sections are only of order 10⁻²⁹ cm²/sr, and the count rate is proportional to laser photon flux, molecular number density, sampled length, collection solid angle and optical transmission, so any loss turns directly into longer integration. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Objective focus and confocal pinhole”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A Raman laser needs a narrow linewidth and a stable wavelength: the linewidth convolves into every Raman band and wavelength drift becomes shift error directly. Amplified spontaneous emission from diode lasers and plasma lines from gas lasers must be removed with a narrow clean-up filter or they appear as false peaks. On the collection side Rayleigh light and specular reflection are six to ten orders of magnitude stronger than the Raman light, so an interference long-pass edge filter or a volume-Bragg-grating notch filter with optical density OD 6 or more is required; the filter transition width sets the lowest measurable wavenumber, and tilting away from the design angle moves the edge toward shorter wavelength. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Laser clean-up and edge filters”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Raman light leaving the confocal pinhole enters a Czerny–Turner spectrograph: the entrance slit is collimated, the grating sends each wavelength to a different angle through mλ = d(sin α + sin β), and a focusing mirror images the spectrum onto a back-illuminated CCD. The reciprocal linear dispersion dλ/dx = cos β/(m·G·f) sets the wavenumber per pixel, the slit image width sets the instrument linewidth and the CCD length sets the range covered per exposure; denser gratings and longer focal lengths improve resolution but shrink the range so broad spectra must be stitched. The CCD is cooled thermoelectrically or with liquid nitrogen below −60 °C to suppress dark current, and pixels are binned along the slit to reduce the weight of read noise. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Grating spectrograph and CCD array”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Wavenumber calibration has two steps: atomic lines of known wavelength from neon, argon or mercury lamps map pixels to absolute wavelength and correct the grating angle and dispersion nonlinearity, then the silicon 520.7 cm⁻¹ band or another known Raman band fixes the actual laser wavelength, the zero-shift point, because laser drift translates the whole shift axis. For stress metrology from the silicon band, roughly 500 MPa of uniaxial stress corresponds to 1 cm⁻¹, so a 0.1 cm⁻¹ calibration error is a 50 MPa stress error; peak positions must be fitted with Lorentzian or Voigt functions to sub-pixel precision, and lamp and laser wavelengths must consistently be air or vacuum values. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Si 520.7 cm⁻¹ and neon calibration lines”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Raman cross-sections are many orders of magnitude smaller than fluorescence, so a trace of fluorescence from the sample or an impurity buries the Raman bands under a broad background. A polynomial can subtract the mean background but its shot noise √B remains, so the true signal-to-noise ratio is S/√(S + B + D + σ_read²). Remedies include 785 or 1064 nm excitation to avoid electronic absorption, photobleaching with the laser beforehand, time gating or shifted-excitation difference methods; longer wavelengths lose signal through ν⁴ and falling CCD quantum efficiency, so the decision must rest on signal-to-noise rather than signal size. Relative intensities across settings also need instrument-response correction with fluorescent standard glasses such as NIST SRM 2241 for 785 nm. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Fluorescence background and CCD noise floor”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A high-NA objective concentrates a few milliwatts into a spot under 1 µm, giving peak irradiance of order MW/cm², and absorbed power heats the sample locally; the temperature rise scales inversely with thermal conductivity and spot radius, so silicon warms by only tens of kelvin while dark polymers, carbon materials or biological tissue may burn or change phase. Heating red-shifts and broadens bands and cannot be separated once it mixes with stress or composition signals. Raman imaging synchronises a motorised stage, autofocus, exposure and readout, so total map time, focal-plane flatness and cosmic-ray spike handling must all be budgeted in advance. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Laser irradiance and mapping stage”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Acceptance of a Raman microspectrometer turns the earlier models into fixed tests: neon line shapes verify instrument linewidth and dispersion, the silicon 520.7 cm⁻¹ band verifies position, repeatability and counts per milliwatt, a Z scan verifies confocal depth, an SRM intensity standard verifies relative response, a power meter measures the real power at the sample, and low-wavenumber and anti-Stokes measurements verify the filter edges. The handoff record must hold calibration coefficients for every laser–grating combination, objective and pinhole settings, measured linewidths and count rates, ambient temperature and the safe power limit for each sample class, because a change in any of them invalidates day-to-day or instrument-to-instrument comparison. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Si, neon and intensity-standard acceptance table”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfalls: 換了雷射或雷射波長漂移後仍沿用舊的 λ₀ 換算，整條位移軸平移，0.2 nm 的差異在 532 nm 就是約 7 cm⁻¹，比對資料庫時錯認物相；以反斯托克斯比值測溫卻沒有修正偵測器在兩側的響應差異，推得的溫度可錯 20 K 以上。
只在早上校正一次，實驗室溫度漂移 2 K 讓光譜儀與雷射波長改變，下午量到的矽峰偏移 0.3 cm⁻¹，被報告成 150 MPa 的應力差異；不同機台各自校正卻採用不同的矽參考值（520.0 對 520.7 cm⁻¹），跨廠資料出現系統性不一致。
pitfallsEn: Keeping the old λ₀ after a laser change or wavelength drift shifts the whole shift axis, and a 0.2 nm difference at 532 nm is about 7 cm⁻¹, enough to misidentify phases against a library; using the anti-Stokes ratio as a thermometer without correcting the detector response on the two sides can put the inferred temperature off by more than 20 K.

Calibrating only once in the morning while the laboratory drifts 2 K changes the spectrometer and laser wavelength, so afternoon silicon peaks shift 0.3 cm⁻¹ and are reported as a 150 MPa stress difference; instruments calibrated separately against different silicon reference values (520.0 versus 520.7 cm⁻¹) produce systematically inconsistent data between sites.

related.differenceEn: This course focuses on raman shift, confocal sampling, Rayleigh rejection, grating dispersion, wavenumber calibration and laser-heating budgets; Fourier-transform infrared spectrometers centres on michelson interferometer, HeNe sampling, resolution and signal-to-noise trade-offs in FTIR engineering, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 拉曼顯微光譜儀
history.text: 1928 年 C. V. Raman 與 K. S. Krishnan 在加爾各答以濾過的太陽光與汞燈觀察到液體的非彈性散射，同年 Landsberg 與 Mandelstam 在莫斯科於石英中獨立發現同一效應，Raman 於 1930 年獲諾貝爾物理獎。1960 年代雷射讓拉曼光譜成為實用技術，1975 年 Delhaye 與 Dhamelincourt 在法國里爾發表雷射拉曼微探針，由 Jobin Yvon（今 HORIBA）商品化；1990 年代 CCD、全像陷波濾光片與共軛焦設計讓拉曼顯微光譜儀成為材料、半導體應力與製藥分析的日常工具。本課只重建公開的物理與工程邏輯。
history.textEn: In 1928 C. V. Raman and K. S. Krishnan in Calcutta observed inelastic scattering from liquids using filtered sunlight and mercury lamps, while Landsberg and Mandelstam in Moscow independently found the same effect in quartz that year, and Raman received the 1930 Nobel Prize in Physics. Lasers made Raman spectroscopy practical in the 1960s, and in 1975 Delhaye and Dhamelincourt in Lille published the laser Raman microprobe that Jobin Yvon, now HORIBA, commercialised; in the 1990s CCDs, holographic notch filters and confocal designs made the Raman microspectrometer a routine tool for materials, semiconductor stress and pharmaceutical analysis. This course reconstructs only public physics and engineering logic.

history.title: 從工程史到可驗證模型
history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「非彈性散射與拉曼位移」到「性能驗收與工程交接」改寫為 32 個原創分析、量測與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "Inelastic scattering and the Raman shift" through "Performance acceptance and engineering handoff" into 32 original analysis, measurement and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts or field procedures.
